title: A Matter of Life and Death
summary: Hayat, a believer in superstitions, is convinced that an inherited curse will kill her on her thirtieth birthday. Yusuf, a brilliant but introverted heart surgeon, suffers from a slow heartbeat that only quickens when holding a scalpel. Together, they plan a mad scheme to cheat death, igniting a chain of chaos, comedy and an impossible love racing against time. Anas Batheef Anas Batheef is a multidisciplinary filmmaker who continuously re-examines himself through works that delve into themes such as identity, belonging, nostalgia, childhood traumas and their psychological effects.
